questions.answer: My initial exchange was cancelled due to COVID19. Afterwards, I didn't have much preferance apart from going somewhere, and I was lucky to get a spot at Utrecht. Therefor, I didn't have a lot of knoledge about the university or city and didn't really "choose".

questions.answer: It's convenient as it is close to most other exchange students. The campus is located just 15-20 minutes bikeride from the city. The housing is acceptable although not nearly as charming (or expensive) as the housing in the town of Utrecht.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
Loads of interesting courses. I think I would have been more satisfied with the academic programme if most of my courses hadn't been online due to COVID19.
The biggest chock for me was the weekly assignments which are expected to be handed in for most of the courses. Although this is more stressing during the semester than what I am used to at Copenhagen University, the exam period was comparatively less stressfull.
I thought the amount of weekly group work/discussion groups was great. 
Also I got personal feedback for the first time on my bachelor, that was a super experience :)

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
The general level was challenging. 
Criminal Behaviour during the Lifecourse (200700018) - Level 3
Theory Construction and Statistical Modeling	 (200300125) - Level 3
ADS: Fundamental techniques in data science with R (201900026) - Level 2
Measurement and modelling with social data	(201800138) - Level 3

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The teaching style is very comparable. The teacher/student relation is not very hierarchical and teachers encourage questions and discussion in class/lectures.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Criminal Behaviour during the Lifecourse (200700018)
Theory Construction and Statistical Modeling	 (200300125)
ADS: Fundamental techniques in data science with R (201900026)
Measurement and modelling with social data	(201800138)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Criminal Behaviour during the Lifecourse (200700018) - Very good introduction to criminology! Weekly lecture and discussion group makes for a great learning experience.
Theory Construction and Statistical Modeling	 (200300125) - Be careful with signing up if you have no prior experience in programming in R.
ADS: Fundamental techniques in data science with R (201900026) - Great introduction to programming in R. Also focuses on basic statistical principles which was sometime a bit repetive from former stats courses. 
Measurement and modelling with social data	(201800138) - If you wan't to get better at programming in Stata, this is a great course.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Join the ultimate frisbee club UTKA! Even if you have no experience with ultimate, I would recommend UTKA. It's a great way to meet very friendly dutch and internationals, break a sweat and attend all the social events and turnaments!
Go cannoying, have a walk in the forrest, check out all the great caffé's and bars around town, go to the flower market, eat waffles, enjoy the grey weather.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Go to Belgium or have a look around Utrecht.
Go cannoying, have a walk in the forrest, check out all the great caffé's and bars around town, go to the flower market, eat waffles, enjoy the grey weather.
